page.overview:
Who is Belgruff the Bludgeoner?

Belgruff the Bludgeoner was a goblin who was one of Ranrok's Loyalists.

Belgruff was originally a peaceful member of the goblin rights movement. However, after associating with Ranrok, he became militant and was transformed into a corrupted goblin, his newfound taste for power gradually consuming him. In 1890, the Bludgeoner accompanied Ranrok when his leader ventured to Vault 12 at Gringotts Wizarding Bank, where the goblin rebels confronted Professor Eleazar Fig and a new student. Watching as Ranrok exchanged words with the two of them, Belgruff shook his head when a Goblin Banker that had accompanied them voiced his objections to their presence, then witnessed his subsequent execution. When the conversation between Fig and Ranrok broke down into a duel between the two, Belgruff and their other companion both stumbled back, and the Bludgeoner was later thrown off his feet from the vibrations caused by the sword blow of a sentinel guardian that had been awakened. While the goblins fought off the sentinel with corrupt magic, their opponents escaped from the scene.
